Custom Tissue Paper: Printing, GSM and Branding for Gift Packaging

Published August 22, 2026 · Buyer guide · By BestPackFactory

Quick answer

Specify tissue paper by sheet size, gsm (typically 17–30 gsm), print colors and logo placement. Confirm whether printing is on one or two sides, the fold and packing format, and whether food-contact suitability is needed. Order a printed proof sheet before the bulk run.

Decision table

SpecificationTypical choiceBuyer check
GSM17–30 gsm tissueDrape and durability
PrintFlexo 1–4 colors or offsetColor depth on tissue
SizeSheet or roll by box sizeFold to fit box
PackingFolded stacks or rollsCount per bundle
ExtrasLogo, pattern, food-contactUse case

Tissue prints differently from board

Thin tissue absorbs ink differently, so logos can look lighter or bleed. Ask for a printed proof sheet, approve color and sharpness, and check how the print looks when wrapped around products.

Match gsm to the job

Lighter tissue (17–20 gsm) drapes softly for wrapping; heavier tissue (25–30 gsm) holds structure for bag lining and inserts. Confirm the gsm with the wrapping style your team uses.

Food contact and special uses

If tissue touches food, confirm food-contact suitability of paper and inks for your market. For luxury cosmetics, check ink rub and whether the tissue leaves marks on products.

Ordering and packing

Confirm sheet size, folded dimensions, count per bundle and carton packing. Tissue is bulky in freight, so compare packed carton volume between suppliers when pricing.

Buyer checklist

  1. Approve a printed proof sheet
  2. Confirm gsm for wrapping style
  3. Check food-contact needs
  4. Verify print rub on products
  5. Compare packed carton volume

Frequently asked questions

Can tissue paper be printed in full color?

Yes, but colors appear lighter on thin tissue; approve a proof and adjust design accordingly.

What gsm should I choose?

17–20 gsm for soft wrapping, 25–30 gsm for structure and lining; confirm with a sample.

Does tissue paper need food-grade certification?

Only if it contacts food; confirm suitability with the supplier for your market.

What the Spec Means for Buyers

Custom tissue paper is a gsm and print decision that sits outside the box spec. Tissue is specified by gsm and printed offset, flexo or digital; finishes can include matte or gloss effects where the stock allows. MOQ is 500 PCS per design and artwork, and the free dieline process covers layout and repeat positioning. For gift sets, tissue is usually paired with folding cartons or rigid boxes from the same project, with sampling 5–7 working days after artwork confirmation.

Frequently Asked Questions

How is tissue paper customized?

Tissue is printed by gsm and design from your artwork, with repeat positioning confirmed on the free dieline.

What is the MOQ for printed tissue?

MOQ is 500 PCS per design and artwork.
